# @sharadox/time-web-library

> Time-zone-correct time helpers for local business sites.

- /zone-minute minutesInZone(date, zone); /format-time formatTime(date, zone) → "HH:MM"
- /open-state openState(now, [h,m], [h,m], zone) → "before"|"open"|"after"
- /round-down roundDown(date, stepMinutes, beforeMinutes=0) → Date
- /sun-time sunTimes(date, lat, lng) → { rise, set }; /sun-today useSunToday(lat, lng) → { rise, set, now, tomorrow } | null ("use client")
- Peer: react (for the hook). License: Sharadox Open Source License 0.1.0
- /opening-status openingStatus(now, { days (ISO 1=Mon), periods [{ opens, closes }], timeZone, closures? [{ from, to } dates, inclusive] }) → { open, closure?, change { day, time, inDays, date } }; nextClosure(now, hours) (earliest not ended); reopening(closure, hours) (first open date after)
- /copyright-years <CopyrightYears since={1996} /> → "1996–<current year>" or "<year>" in the first year; the browser writes the current year after hydration
